candidate.definition_en: To give out or reflect a bright light; to be very good at something.
candidate.explanation_ar: يا إما حاجة بتنور وتلمع، يا إما حد بيتألق وبيبقى شاطر جداً في حاجة.

senses.definition_en: To produce or reflect bright light.
To perform exceptionally well; to excel.
senses.definition_ar: يتألق أو يُظهر مهارة وتفوقاً كبيراً.

examples: The stars shine brightly in the clear night sky.
This competition is a great chance for you to shine.
Please shine a light on the path so we do not trip.
